Priya: heads-up: we're doing an ephemeral-signer experiment to sign rebuilt base images this week. objective: test narrow RBAC, full audit capture, and a rollback path if signature verification fails.
Dan: nice. window? will this touch any existing deploy pipelines?
Priya: minimal. CI will push canaries to a staging repo only. signer SA created with least privilege. no changes to production deploy service accounts.
Kai: what exact perms? want to ensure we don't accidentally allow read/modify on KMS keys.
Priya: perms: roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner (specific key), roles/logging.logWriter on audit project, and storage.objectCreator on gs://image-signatures-staging. nothing else.
Dan: pls share IAM snippet for infra repo. also we should add an allowlist of callers by IP for the signer SA.
Priya: putting it here:
```bash
# create ephemeral SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create ephem-signer --display-name="ephemeral image signer"
# grant cryptoSigner for single key
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-infra/locations/global/keyRings/signer/cryptoKeys/cosign 
  --member=serviceAccount:ephem-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner
# logging write
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-audit --member=serviceAccount:ephem-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/logging.logWriter
# storage writer for signatures
gsutil iam ch serviceAccount:ephem-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com:objectCreator gs://image-signatures-staging
```
Kai: good. Add a conditional IAM binding if possible (e.g., request.time < ...), otherwise key version rotation policy should be very short (hours).
Priya: rotation planned: create key version, grant use for 2h, revoke. all steps automated in pipeline.
Dan: audit sink? customers need immutable evidence for forensics.
Priya: yes. we'll write KMS Data Access + Storage Data Access to a restricted logs project with 3y retention and object immutability for 90 days.
Kai: make sure audit entries include a correlation ID. propose adding labels: `correlation=image-rebuild-<run_id>` and `stage=canary`.
Priya: agreed. we'll inject headers into the sign request so the log entry has the correlation id.
ci-bot: CI: canary build triggered by PR #882; running image unit tests.
Dan: threat note: CVE-2026-1234 (hypo) surfaced in libc build. image-qa says low exploitability but security wants rebuild now. canary should include that fix.
Priya: marking this canary high-priority and tagging the release.
Kai: operational alerting: create two alerts - (1) unexpected sign frequency: if ephem-signer signs >5 images in 5m, (2) sign calls outside 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12.
Priya: @ops-bot can you schedule those alerts?
ops-bot: Alert created: ephem-signer-frequency (threshold=5/5m). Alert created: ephem-signer-geo (notify on unusual source). Channels: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime.
Dan: rollback path: CI should publish unsigned image tag and a verification step in deploy that rejects unsigned artifacts. also we need a signed-manifest verifier runnable locally.
Priya: verifier in repo: `tools/verify-signature.sh` uses cosign verify with the KMS public key. will add quick invocation in runbook.
Kai: runbook checklist: 1) revoke key version, 2) block SA in IAM, 3) revert image tag to previous signed artifact, 4) run forensics on logs with correlation id.
Priya: I'll update the runbook and open a PR with the IAM + sink + runbook changes.
ci-bot: CI: canary signed successfully, signature uploaded to gs://image-signatures-staging/run-2026-03-21/sig.json
Dan: verification step succeeded locally for me. canary promoted to extended staging.
Priya: post-canary: archive signatures to long-term bucket with object lock for 1y for customers who require provenance. also produce an attestation note in the artifact metadata.
Kai: keep me posted on any anomalous logs. if we see unexpected key usage pattern we'll initiate keys rotation and a security incident review.
Priya: thanks. action items: Priya PR for IAM+sink; Dan adds verifier checks to deploy pipeline; Kai draft alert thresholds; ops-bot creates alerts (done). back to work. :white_check_mark:
